citation: NCHS, Leading Causes of Death: United States (data.cdc.gov dataset bi63-dtpu), all causes, age-adjusted death rate per 100,000, 2017, the latest final year it carries: United States 731.9. Each state's ratio to the national rate scales the SSA cohort life table for people there. Read Oct. 13, 2026.
territories: Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands are not in the dataset and take the national rate (ratio 1), an estimate from the average.
